scope: Selected RoadAhead helper lines836..868 and crossing/curve consumer2868..2894; CBE full road observer. Not renewed whole-source parity.

reference.intent: Bounded forward road connectivity walk observes junctions and bend ahead. Source uses road object origins, conditional crossing-traffic45km/h and curve38/27km/h ceilings.

finding: CBE already reads endpoint midpoints for grade and segment distance, but used the origin-derived candidate turn in its final measured turn maximum. An offset selected-road origin can hide or invent a local bend, including an endpoint right-angle turn whose vehicle-to-endpoint bearing remains small.
implementation: After reading the selected next road, compute segment heading and local turn from endpoint midpoints; use that same heading as the next-step basis. Keep cumulative vehicle-to-piece approach angle. No added metadata query, scan, cache, controller or threshold change.
limits: Candidate branch selection and its 110-degree cutoff still use origin-based heading heuristics, not native planned-route proof. The patch corrects accepted-piece curvature only; it is not complete road-graph disambiguation. Existing CBE conservative junction/grade policy differs from source balance. Normal/HC road handling and median/p95 budget unverified; audits paused. No parity percentage increase.
